sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move green down, then try to move path up to blue's level
# First, move down multiple times
result = action(['DOWN', 'DOWN'])
print(f"After 2x DOWN: done={result.get('done')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
print("\n=== State ===")

# Check path
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if 20 <= min_r <= 50:
            max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
            print(f"  Path: row {min_r}, cols 17-{max_c}")

# Check blocks
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] in ('R', 'b', 'N') and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if min_r < 55:
            print(f"  Block {n['color']}: rows {min_r}-{max(p[0] for p in b)}")

# Now try UP to see if path can reach blue's level
if not result.get('done'):
    result2 = action(['UP'])
    print(f"\nAfter UP: done={result2.get('done')}, gameplay_changed={result2.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    print("\n=== After UP ===")
    for n in seg2:
        if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4:
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            if 20 <= min_r <= 50:
                max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
                print(f"  Path: row {min_r}")
        if n['color'] in ('R', 'b', 'N') and n['pixels'] == 16:
            b = n['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            if min_r < 55:
                print(f"  Block {n['color']}: rows {min_r}-{max(p[0] for p in b)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
